name: boxbox
description: The Jackbox Megapicker is your all-in-one solution for organizing, buying, and launching all of your Jackbox games.
author: Jackbox Games <jbg@jackboxgames.com> (https://jackboxgames.com)

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env') && fs.existsSync('../.env')) fs.copyFileSync('../.env', '.env'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env') && fs.existsSync('.env.example')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.example', '.env'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/electron/dist/steam_appid.txt') && fs.existsSync('steam_appid.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('steam_appid.txt', 'node_modules/electron/dist/steam_appid.txt');"
scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/electron/dist/steam_appid.txt') && fs.existsSync('steam_appid.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('steam_appid.txt', 'node_modules/electron/dist/steam_appid.txt');" && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:mac:x64 && npm run package:mac:arm && node scripts/make-universal.mjs
scripts.schema: npm run schema:home && npm run schema:games && npm run schema:products
scripts.schema:home: npx typescript-json-schema tsconfig.json BoxBox.HomeJSON --include src/shared/types/BoxBox.ts --out schema.home.json
scripts.schema:games: npx typescript-json-schema tsconfig.json BoxBox.GamesJSON --include src/shared/types/BoxBox.ts --out schema.games.json
scripts.schema:products: npx typescript-json-schema tsconfig.json BoxBox.ProductsJSON --include src/shared/types/BoxBox.ts --out schema.products.json
